i18n.enSummary: When asked about the effects of introducing an AI agent, many managers are unable to convert the time saved into monetary terms. ROI can be calculated by subtracting the total cost from the benefits obtained from implementation and dividing by the total cost. However, the cost of AI agents changes each time they are executed, so the same estimates as traditional SaaS will result in different numbers. If you proceed without measuring the numbers before implementation, you will not be able to demonstrate the effectiveness and your budget will be cut off. Once you understand the calculation formula and cost breakdown, you can create a trial calculation that can be used directly for approval.
